topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I just found out my apartment building is turning into condos. It’s like waking up to a whole new world, where the familiar turns into the unknown. My cozy, rent-controlled haven might soon be a place where neighbors become unfamiliar, or worse, might not even stick around. They say change is the only constant, but this feels like an unexpected turn of the page. Now, I have to decide if I stay and join this new chapter or find a fresh start elsewhere. It’s a lot to digest, and the room feels suddenly smaller, the walls closer.
